notes: Names as printed: DORCHESTER AV., SYCAMORE, WALKER, S. AUBURN AV., PARK PL., BIGELOW, CARMALT, JOSEPHINE, YOUNG, CHANNING, RINGGOLD, DRAKE (no suffixes except AV./PL.). Auburn Avenue north of Dorchester is named from sheet 173 (AUBURN AV.); south of Dorchester the sheet prints S. AUBURN AV. (recorded South Auburn Avenue, as on sheet 157), so both names are recorded at the Dorchester crossing. Dorchester's west leg (40 ft, y~647) is the continuation of the Dorchester Av. printed along the top of sheet 163; it jogs ~24 ft to the east leg (50 ft, y~726). The Auburn/Dorchester/Sycamore junction is an open plaza: Auburn north of Dorchester is 60 ft (faces x 900-1105, pipes at 962, 1010, 1052); South Auburn is ~26 ft (faces x 1005-1092) down to y~2680 and then only ~10 ft (faces x 1056-1090) to Ringgold. Sycamore (no width printed here; 70 ft on 163) enters from the left edge and ends at South Auburn. Walker ends at Sycamore (block north of it) and at Ringgold (Ringgold does not continue west). Hopkins Park fills the block Dorchester / South Auburn / Park Pl / Bigelow. Park Pl (~20 ft) runs South Auburn to Bigelow; Carmalt starts at Bigelow ~15 ft further south and runs to Young, where its east leg continues ~34 ft further north (sheet 165 CARMALT). Bigelow dead-ends at y~3333; the area south of that between South Auburn and Josephine is one block. Channing comes in from the right edge and ends at Young. Drake (DRAKE) runs south from Ringgold at x~1882 (faces 1816-1949). The courtyard between the two Park Pl row blocks (x~1280-1440) is enclosed (no street). Walker centre drifts from x~594 (Sycamore) to ~578 (Ringgold).
